examples.arabic: ذهب الأصدقاء إلى متجر كبير لشراء ملابس جديدة
examples.english: The friends went to a large store to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: dhahaba al asdiqa ila matjar kabir lishira malabis jadida

examples.arabic: هناك قابلوا اصدقاء وقالوا السلام عليكم
examples.english: There they met friends and said As-salamu alaykum.
examples.transliteration: Hunaka qabaloo asdiqa wa qaloo as-salamu alaykum.
examples.storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

examples.arabic: بعد الغداء اجلس مع الاصدقاء واشرب القهوة
examples.english: After lunch I sit with friends and drink coffee.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd al-ghada' ajlis ma'a al-asdiqa' wa ashrab al-qahwah.

examples.arabic: يريدون يوما جميلا لكل العائلة والاصدقاء
examples.english: They want a beautiful day for all the family and friends
examples.transliteration: Yureedoona yawman jameelan likulli al-'a'ilati wal-asdiqa'i

examples.arabic: كثير منهم كانوا يجتمعون لصلة الرحم وتبادل الاخبار مع العائلة والاصدقاء
examples.english: Many of them were gathering to maintain family bonds and exchange news with family and friends.
examples.transliteration: Katheer minhum kanu yajtami'un li-ṣilat ar-raḥim wa tabadul al-akhbar ma'al-'ailah wal-asdiqa'.

examples.arabic: كانت العائلة والأصدقاء يشجعون بحماس كبير من المدرجات
examples.english: The extended family and friends were cheering with great enthusiasm from the stands
examples.transliteration: Kānat al-ʿā'ilah wa-al-aṣdiqā' yushajjiʿūn bi-ḥamās kabīr min al-madarrajāt
